productChange: The sticky reply bar uses an opaque canvas background and no backdrop filter. Layout, focus styling, draft state and recovery code are unchanged.

build.command: npm run build:kernel; npx vite build --sourcemap hidden
build.warning: Existing 523.18 kB DailyRoot chunk warning remains

syntax: node --check passed for profile-electron.mjs and performance-profiles.mjs

comparisons.exclusionReason: Initial aborted run lost characters while unfocused. Four subsequent runs recovered focus during reply typing; all four were replaced based on focus contamination, not their timing values.

productionScenarios.computedStyle: backdropFilter none, opaque rgb(248, 250, 249), position sticky
productionScenarios.draftChecks: Exact initial and appended reply text preserved through concurrent reads and detail expansion/collapse; composer draft also verified
productionScenarios.focusCaveat: Standard run recovered focus in the earlier composer phase; both reply phases were unaffected. Large run had no focus recoveries.
productionScenarios.visualReview: Inspected 1400x900 screenshot: complete draft visible, sticky reply bar and Send button aligned, solid surface matches canvas

profilePair.archiveContents: Two main-process CPU profiles, two renderer CPU profiles, two Chromium timelines, and matching built JavaScript/CSS/source maps
profilePair.scope: Opening and first-reply phases only; both later reply bursts had focus recoveries and were excluded from attribution
profilePair.limitation: Trace spans measure GPU-process thread activity, not GPU hardware execution; native shader/driver attribution is incomplete

target: Measured improvement established. First-burst p95 below 50 ms is not consistently established; later-burst sampled p95 remained 16-24 ms.
environment: Windows; Ryzen 7 3800X; NVIDIA RTX 3080 driver 32.0.15.9186; accelerated ANGLE D3D11 and Skia GaneshGL; production bundle in development Electron host
shutdownCaveat: Complete GPU-info collection occurs after measured phases. Some runs print a command-buffer error during forced shutdown after successful assertions and report generation. No typing-time GPU crash is inferred.
scopeLimits: Small thresholded Event Timing samples, synthetic settled runs and injected input. Not an installed-release, live-stream, cross-GPU or soak validation. Full suite was run for the preceding startup change; this CSS follow-up reran the focused performance and Work suites.
